scoring_justification: Recompute is infeasible because agent provides only final sigma_y/sigma_f values without intermediate system selections; comparing to paper-reported hidden gold values with tolerance is the feasible verification.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold yield/fracture stresses for five tensile axes
hidden_assets.generation_method: Transcribed from the paper's reported σy and σf values (columns σy/MPa and σf/MPa) for axes A,B,C,D,N
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are exact numbers from the published paper; they are the ground truth for reproduction.

outputs.description: Predicted yield and fracture stresses for lamellar TiAl tensile orientations
